text: Hello! Ready for today? Let's find out what the weather is like on this Friday, November 6. Friday at last. One more day and it's the weekend. Shanghai is going to be grey from start to finish today. It will reach 20 degrees, and drop down to 13 degrees. A mild sort of day, easy to be outside in. You probably won't need a raincoat today. Here's something to notice: today is almost exactly as warm as yesterday. Two days the same in a row! Look up at the clouds today. Can you find one shaped like an animal? And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be cloudy with hardly any sun, with a high of 19 degrees. Tell someone about animals getting ready for winter today. And that's the weather. Have a brilliant day!
